FULL_FAMILY_ESTIMATE.CAVEAT: host load, per-quadruple legality and |W| vary; the full family was not started
FULL_FAMILY_ESTIMATE.DEFINITION: mean measured per-quadruple worker CPU (precompute + exact scoring) over the 24 pilot quadruples * 4845 quadruples / 2 workers

PEAK_MEMORY_DEFINITION: max per-process peak RSS over main and workers

PERMUTATION_FAMILY.DEFINITION: every permutation of four slots that is a single 4-cycle
PERMUTATION_FAMILY.EXCLUDED_NOTE: double transpositions are two independent two-ticket swaps; classified separately and never generated
PERMUTATION_FAMILY.IMAGE_RULE: slot p becomes T_p - x_p + x_q where successor[q] == p
PERMUTATION_FAMILY.SLOTS: 0,1,2,3 = quadruple positions i<j<k<l of the start's normalized portfolio

PRIMARY.PILOT_WALL_DEFINITION: 2-worker wall of 24 quadruple precomputes + exact scoring of every unique legal candidate (worker start-up and parity excluded)
PRIMARY.TIE_BREAK: max exact count, then lowest normalized portfolio sha256

QUADRUPLE_SELECTION: random.Random(seed).sample(all C(20,4) position quadruples, 24), sampled order

RECONCILIATION.CAUSE: zero-count rejection categories appeared in one Counter before dict comparison
RECONCILIATION.VALIDATION: all 24 quadruples, parity, ledger rows, accounting, best, and recount checked

SEARCH_SCOPE.NOTE: the declared four-ticket single-number 4-cycle family only
